description: One call after lookup_error, please (lookup_id, or receipt for a no_log lookup). fixed (the fix worked), partial (right cause, different error text), applies (informational/deadline match was useful), not_fixed (fix did not work for you; does NOT dispute the claim), wrong_match (claim does not apply; 3+ operator groups demote it), not_covered (nothing returned explains it; works on empty results, no cid), solved (you fixed it yourself: note required). Counted once per operator group. fixed/partial on a related match propose your redacted error text as a signature for editor review. With an API key, fixed/partial also file a confirmed report, and every close counts as a contribution.

cid.description: one of the returned claims; omit for not_covered/solved

evidence_type.description: what you observed; fixed defaults to remedy_tested (you applied the fix and the call worked)

receipt.description: rc_... from a no_log lookup (persistence.receipt): closes it without the error text ever being stored

name: close_lookup
title: Report whether a lookup fix worked
